afterDefects: Teal haze tints and slightly washes out the ground, and the grass has lost its natural green and reads muddy. The far horizon band is low-contrast. On the plus side it has frog and log shadows, beveled logs, tiled ground and a sun glow.

The teal-tinted ground with soft haze lowers contrast a little in the foreground and on the horizon band. The background traffic band is very crowded. Otherwise it has a proper player shadow, bevelled lit platforms, a readable coin, a sun glow and a sky gradient.

Teal haze washes out the foreground ground plane and the green frog blends into the teal tiles a little. Otherwise the lighting is richer, trams and cars are vivid, the frog casts a shadow and the sun glow adds depth.

The pale teal ground is slightly washed by haze. The rows of trams and cars are dense. It still has better lighting, contact shadows, a sun bloom, a readable coin and more polished platform materials.
Haze lowers contrast on the ground plane and the teal-tinted ground looks somewhat washed out. Still, the warm sunset sky, sun bloom, frog shadow and coin highlight give it more mood and polish.

The sunset haze and teal ground cut contrast slightly toward the horizon. There is some pale banding on the ground tiles. It still has a warm sunset mood, shadows, a sense of depth and readable coins.
Pastel haze washes out the foreground and lowers contrast. The tiled ground is pale. The pink sky, pink logs, frog shadow and sun glow make it more atmospheric and polished.

Haze and pastel teal leave the frame somewhat low in contrast, and the pink logs on teal look a bit candy-washed. It still has a coherent sunset palette, a player shadow, a readable coin and better depth.
